twin_b.name: Tyrell Fortune

Últimas 5 peleas: 3-2 con KO loss vs Nascimento (cortó mal), TKO loss vs Lins; wins over Barriault y Copeland Reyes por decisión. Origen wrestling NCAA Div II 2x campeón nacional - grappling sólido pero cardio en rounds 3 puede verse afectado por corte. Motivación alta tras última salida UFC - busca regreso, pero ring rust evidente con baja actividad.

twin_b.name: Tim Tszyu
twin_b.notes: - Lost UD to Sebastian Fundora (April 2024) - eyebrow split changed fight dynamics, showed toughness. - Beat Tony Harrison (UD) and Mendoza (TKO) before that - relentless pressure, heavy hooks, tight guard. - Training with father Kostya Tszyu - technical boxing foundation, physically imposing 154lbs champ. - 6'0" reach advantage at 154, lacks elite-level speed but applies intelligent pressure. - No serious weight cut issues historically, good cardio past round 8. - High motivation: family legacy, WBO/Lineal titles at stake, redemption narrative. - Ring rust minimal: fought Fundora March 2024 (short-notice replacement for Spence).
twin_b.sources: Multiple boxing outlets reported Tszyu-Fundora outcome and stats; fight scheduled for March 30, 2024 originally vs Spence then Fundora replaced Spence due to Spence injury.
